dct_description_sm:
VARIABLES
LAKE: Lake from where the sample was taken 
YEAR: Year when the sample was taken 
DATE: Date when the sample was taken following the format of MM/DD/YYY
DEPTH: Depth from surface where temperature and oxygen reading were taken 
TEMP: Temperature, numeric (integer or decimal) - water temperature in degrees Celsius 
OXYGEN: Dissolved Oxygen mg/L taken with a YSI 550A or YSI Pro20 dissolved oxygen meter

This data file contains a compilation of water temperature and oxygen data for 32 lakes in Ontario for the years of 2012, 2013, 2014, 2015, 2016, 2017 and 2018 processed at the Dorset Enviromental Science Centre http://desc.ca/
This data file is related to two other Dataverse data sets: EnviromentalVariables2012-2016.csv and waterChemestry.csv
